scope: Proposition 8.28 (Rigidity from local forcing) of the manuscript “Metric-measure limits of subcritical FK and spanning-tree planar maps” (preprints/Metric-measure-limits-of-subcritical-FK-and-spanning-tree-planar-maps-September-24-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 211 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 1dd659698d3a3fde), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF pages 91-92. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. The quote crosses a page break and includes whatever the extraction places there, such as a page number. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Suppose the comparison family satisfies the hypotheses of Proposition 8.15. Assume in addition that the positive-probability rectangular shortcuts can be amplified to a high-probability shell event with a finite deterministic catalogue satisfying Lemma 8.19. The event must include the following data, with constants independent of the scale: (a) regular upper and lower reference bounds of order w = (Mλ−i)p, and a shortcut with denominator in [a′λ−ip, A′λ−ip]; (b) shifts of uniformly bounded amplitude and Dirichlet energy, constant on the complete real-field dependency patch of the retained shortcut, vanishing on the preserved exterior patch; (c) the likelihood clipping of Lemma 8.16, imposed before applying Lemma 8.12; 91 (d) output-observable shell traversal events with a lower reference cost κw and the bounded overlap and alignment multiplicities in Remark 8.18. Assume the exact local product kernels permit the completion and preservation in Lemma 8.16. Then the optimal comparisons coincide, c = C, and FU = CDU for every open U.
